round_prompt: Round {number} of {total}: Your randomly selected door is {choice}. The host opened empty door {revealed}. Switch or stay?
round_result: Round {number}: Prize behind door {prize}; your final choice was {final}. {result}! Wins: {wins}/{total}.

war_instructions: Host: create a Classic Warcraft III LAN game. Joining player: enter the host’s reachable IP and choose the matching edition and version. Start the bridge, then open Local Area Network in Warcraft III.
war_searching: Searching for a LAN game on the host…
war_found: Found: {name}. Open the game’s LAN list to join.
war_network_note: Players need network reachability: use a virtual LAN/VPN, or the host must forward UDP 6112 and the game’s announced TCP port to their PC. Direct public connections are not encrypted.
war_exe_error: Choose an existing Warcraft III .exe file.
war_auto_help: After the lobby server is configured, this app connects automatically and makes other players’ Classic Warcraft III lobbies visible in the game’s LAN menu.
war_setup_note: Keep the server open and share its address, port and certificate fingerprint. IPv4 may require port forwarding; IPv6 requires an enabled listener and firewall access.
war_host_mode: One player can run the shared lobby and relay server on this computer.
war_run_server: Run the lobby server on this computer
war_config_error: Enter a valid server address, port, and 64-character fingerprint.
war_online: Connected. Available remote lobbies: {count}. Open Warcraft III → Local Area Network.
war_local_search: Searching this computer for a hosted LAN game…
war_diag_copied: Diagnostics copied. You can paste them into your support message.
war_local_published: Local game published to the lobby server: {name}.
war_publish_rejected: The lobby server rejected the local game announcement. Copy diagnostics for support.
war_direct_help: For IPv6, enable the server listener and share your current global IPv6 address, port and certificate fingerprint. Both networks need IPv6, and the host firewall/router must allow inbound TCP. The server does not authenticate players; restrict firewall access to trusted players.
war_zt_help: Install ZeroTier separately on both PCs, join and authorize the same network. The server operator shares their ZeroTier IPv4, port, and fingerprint. The check shows local adapter addresses only.
war_zt_main_help: ZeroTier must be installed and both computers joined and authorized on the same network. The host shares their ZeroTier IPv4, server port, and fingerprint.
war_ipv6_enable: Enable IPv6 listening on this server
war_ipv6_listening: IPv6 listener started; internet reachability has not been checked.
war_ipv6_unavailable: IPv6 listener could not start. IPv4 remains available.
door_revealed_prompt: Round {number} of {total}: You chose door {choice}. Door {revealed} is empty. Switch or stay?
voice_eliminated: I have eliminated door {number} for you; would you like to switch doors?
voice_unavailable: No compatible Windows voice was found for this language. Install a matching Windows text-to-speech voice and restart the game.
